symbiotes.name: Plate-Growth Symbiote
symbiotes.description: Adds 5 shields. Cannot be used again for 3 rooms. If the shield is fully consumed, the symbiote takes 1 damage. 3 health.

symbiotes.name: Regenerative Graft
symbiotes.description: Heals 1 per room for 5 rooms. If you are not at full health at the end, it takes 1 damage. 5 health.

symbiotes.name: Doppleganger
symbiotes.description: Doubles your first action in combat when activated. If the enemy damages you, the symbiote takes damage. 3 health.

symbiotes.name: Mitosis Symbiote
symbiotes.description: Saves you from dying one time, then dies.
